achievements.name: Engineer
achievements.description: You repaired (20) objects on and around Talos I.

achievements.name: I and Thou
achievements.description: Complete the game with maximum empathy by helping and saving everyone you can rather than ignoring or harming them.

achievements.name: I and It
achievements.description: You killed every Human on and around Talos I.

achievements.name: No Needles
achievements.description: You completed the game without ever acquiring any Typhon power or Human ability.

achievements.name: Do No Harm
achievements.description: You completed the game without killing any Humans.

achievements.name: Mimic Massacre
achievements.description: You killed (5) Mimics in 5 seconds.

achievements.name: Dead Calm
achievements.description: You killed an enemy while using Combat Focus.

achievements.name: Mimesis
achievements.description: You mimicked a Mimic.

achievements.name: Shapeshifter
achievements.description: You mimicked (20) or more unique objects.

achievements.name: Know Thine Enemy
achievements.description: You acquired a Typhon power.

achievements.name: Know Thy Self
achievements.description: You acquired a Human ability.

achievements.name: Split Affinity
achievements.description: You completed the game once acquiring only Typhon Powers and again acquiring only Human abilities.

achievements.name: Operator
achievements.description: You hacked at least (20) hackable objects on and around Talos I.

achievements.name: A Different Side of Yu
achievements.description: You scanned your Phantom Shift duplicate with the Psychoscope.

achievements.name: Deprogramming
achievements.description: You used Mindjack to free a mind-controlled Human.

achievements.name: Tee One Up
achievements.description: You killed an enemy while they were Lifted.

achievements.name: Escape Velocity
achievements.description: You blasted yourself as an object for at least 20 meters while in normal gravity.

achievements.name: It's Alive!
achievements.description: You created a Phantom using Phantom Genesis.

achievements.name: Thoughts Can Kill
achievements.description: You used Psychoshock on a Human.

achievements.name: Ball Lightning
achievements.description: You used Electrostatic Burst to drop two or more Operators at once.

achievements.name: TranStar Gourmand
achievements.description: You consumed one of every type of food and drink on Talos I.

achievements.name: Cold Dead Hands
achievements.description: You fully upgraded a weapon.

achievements.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
achievements.description: You used a single Recycler Charge to recycle at least 20 objects.

achievements.name: Intrinsic Value
achievements.description: Recycle yourself using a Recycler Charge.

achievements.name: Missing Persons
achievements.description: You located all employees on Talos I.

achievements.name: Press Sneak
achievements.description: You read all the e-mails on Talos I.

achievements.name: Psychometry
achievements.description: You found and listened to all TranScribe recordings.

achievements.name: No Show
achievements.description: Die to the helicopter blades on your very first day at TranStar.

achievements.name: Awkward Ride Home
achievements.description: Escape Talos I aboard Walther Dahl's shuttle with only Dahl as your companion.

achievements.name: Push the Fat Guy
achievements.description: Kill Alex Yu.

achievements.name: Abandon Ship
achievements.description: Flee Talos I aboard Alex's escape pod before completing your mission.

achievements.name: Self-Incriminating
achievements.description: Discover the truth of what happened to Mikhaila's father and tell her.

achievements.name: Brain Trust
achievements.description: Bring Igwe, January, and Mikhaila together to meet in your office.

achievements.name: Dear Future Self
achievements.description: Find and listen to all of the messages you left for your future self.

achievements.name: Best Served Cold
achievements.description: Kill Luka to avenge Abby.

achievements.name: Suicide by Proxy
achievements.description: Kill January.

achievements.name: Open Says She
achievements.description: Use Danielle Sho's voice samples to gain access to Deep Storage.

achievements.name: This Never Happened
achievements.description: Perform an apto-regressive neurotomy on Walther Dahl, erasing his memory.

achievements.name: Facsimile
achievements.description: Meet the Operator January for the first time.

achievements.name: A Friend in Need
achievements.description: Find Mikhaila injured in the Power Plant and give her a medkit.

achievements.name: Prism Master
achievements.description: Find and read all six books of the Starbender Cycle series.

achievements.name: The Gates of Hell
achievements.description: Complete the Shipping and Receiving objective without any human casualties.

achievements.name: Adrift
achievements.description: Answer Dr. Igwe's distress call and save him in time after he is stranded outside the station.

achievements.name: Black Market
achievements.description: Find all of the smuggler's hidden dead drops on Talos I.

achievements.name: You Rang?
achievements.description: Use the Psychotronics satellite to summon or dismiss the Typhon Nightmare.

achievements.name: Makeup Exam
achievements.description: Retake the Neuromod Division's aptitude test and pass all three sections using Kinetic Blast, Mimic Matter, and Remote Manipulation in turn.

achievements.name: Coffee Break
achievements.description: Find Dr. Calvino's secret coffee stash.

achievements.name: Gift to the World
achievements.description: Recover Gustav Leitner's connectome for Dr. Igwe.

achievements.name: Galaxy Brain
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, install every neuromod power for every character.

achievements.name: Squad Goals
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, unlock all 5 playable characters.

achievements.name: Cryptomancer
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, finish the game with a surplus of 50,000 sim points or more.

achievements.name: Psychostatic Efficiency
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, damage 3 enemies with a single Psychostatic Cutter projectile.

achievements.name: Quantum Leap
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, complete all Story Objectives.

achievements.name: I’m Your Biggest Fan
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, you read all of the second Starbender series and still no regrets.

achievements.name: Apex Predator
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, defeat a Moon Shark.

achievements.name: Three-Body Problem
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, GLOO 3 enemies with a single GLOO charge.

achievements.name: Contract Fulfilled
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, complete all KASMA Orders.

achievements.name: No One Left Behind
achievements.description: In Mooncrash, escape the simulation with all five playable characters in a single run.
